name: Project Timesheet Detailed
query:
SELECT
    ts.custom_project AS "Project Name:Link/Project:150",
    ts.employee_name AS "User Name:Data:150",
    tsd.from_time AS "Date:Date:110",
    tsd.task AS "Task:Link/Task:150",
    tsd.description AS "Activity Description:Data:250",
    tsd.hours AS "Hours Entered:Float:100",
    ts.workflow_state AS "Approval Status:Data:120"
FROM
    `tabTimesheet` ts
JOIN
    `tabTimesheet Detail` tsd ON tsd.parent = ts.name
WHERE
    ts.docstatus < 2
    AND (IFNULL(%(employee)s, '') = '' OR ts.employee = %(employee)s)
    AND (IFNULL(%(project)s, '') = '' OR ts.custom_project = %(project)s)
    AND (IFNULL(%(approval_status)s, '') = '' OR ts.workflow_state = %(approval_status)s)
    AND (IFNULL(%(from_date)s, '') = '' OR DATE(tsd.from_time) >= %(from_date)s)
    AND (IFNULL(%(to_date)s, '') = '' OR DATE(tsd.from_time) <= %(to_date)s)
ORDER BY 
    tsd.from_time DESC
